svg.aria-label: HealthyCropping: Point a phone at a coffee leaf and get a diagnosis right there in the field, with no signal. A MobileNetV3 model trained on public coffee datasets runs on the device through TensorFlow Lite. Cacao and banana models come next, along with a Gemini RAG layer that explains what to do and cites official manuals.
